access.account: not required for local CLI preprocessing

access.region: no project-specific restriction identified in the cited open-source licenses

rightsAndPrivacy.biometricData: face, body, and motion imagery remains local but is sensitive personal data
rightsAndPrivacy.retention: keep source footage, transparent derivatives, and model cache outside Git; delete project derivatives according to the project identity and retention record
rightsAndPrivacy.outputRightsBoundary: software and model licenses do not grant portrait, likeness, performance, source-footage, trademark, or publication rights
rightsAndPrivacy.aiLabeling: preserve source and processing provenance and apply current platform or applicable synthetic-media disclosure rules when required

stability.maturity: usable local preprocessing path with shot-level fail-closed approval; not a universal production matte
stability.reproducibility: version, model SHA-256, device choice, quality preset, source timing, and output probe must be recorded for each accepted derivative
knownFailureModes: the upstream human model is not hair-level accurate
frame-oriented masks can crawl or flicker over time
hands, separated fingers, glasses, motion blur, translucent edges, thin props, and foreground objects can be lost or leak
baked captions, cards, logos, or other foreground graphics can enter the subject mask
VP9 alpha requires an alpha-aware decoder; generic FFmpeg probing can report yuv420p unless libvpx-vp9 is selected
CoreML may partition unsupported graph nodes to CPU
stability.vendorLockIn: low for ProRes 4444 or VP9-alpha outputs; medium for exact CLI and model-cache behavior

evidence.scope: one 1.0-second, 30-frame, 720x960 reference excerpt already containing a presenter, graphics, and baked captions; validates local alpha output and exposes why clean A-roll is mandatory, not raw-footage matte quality
evidence.hardware: Apple M3 Max, 36 GB unified memory
artifacts: ephemeral local smoke input and outputs were kept outside Git

recommendation.allowedRole: default local engine for a time-aligned presenter cutout made from clean locked A-roll after canonical timing lock, only when the actual moving matte passes bright, dark, busy-background, boundary, collision, and target-device QA
recommendation.blockedRole: baked-caption or already-composited input, unattended approval, broken matte hidden by an outline, replacement for canonical audio or timing, and redistribution of the runtime or model cache without a full notices review
recommendation.reason: the pinned local CLI produced complete frame-aligned alpha media without uploading the source, while known model limits are containable through a fail-closed per-shot gate and explicit layout fallback
recheckTriggers: HyperFrames version or package source changes
new hardware provider or output format
materially different camera, background, lighting, wardrobe, hair, props, or motion conditions
commercial or public use where source-person rights or platform labeling requirements differ
